function.name: grep
function.description: Searches file contents in the workspace using ripgrep and returns matching lines as workspace-relative path:line:match. Uses ripgrep's default ignore and hidden-file behavior. If results are truncated, narrow the pattern or path.

pattern.description: A non-empty ripgrep regular expression. Matching is case-sensitive by default.

path.description: A directory relative to the agent's startup directory. Defaults to '.' (the workspace root). Absolute paths, paths outside the workspace, and explicit hidden directories are not allowed.
